entries.note: Independent full 277/277 key Hindi/English/context audit @ e9e6c3711149cba6899083eab019342d98d5fa55. Two unresolved MAJOR findings HI-1 (lower-bound referent runtimes vs trajectories), HI-2 (hidden descendants mistranslated as levels); MINOR HI-3 grammar and HI-4 measured terse-fit risk. Both translator and auditor actually used openai/gpt-6.1-sol after anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 quota fallback; distinct sessions. 750 production tr_record cases all source_locale hi; 47 plural nodes/94 count-bearing arms, 23 select nodes and ordered argument/type parity 277. Context-only metadata local JSON fallback after public reader >200000-character size cap, expressly authorized by parent. No native/App/rendered screen, design, CI or ship clearance. Detailed report hi-independent-audit-round1.json and hi-independent-audit-round1.md in auditor scratchpad.

safety_semantics.bound_held: समय-सीमा बीती; चालू states elapsed bound plus alive; does not diagnose hang or grant stop authority; matches HELD_UNPROVEN uncertainty.
safety_semantics.stale: प्रोसेस अब मौजूद नहीं states absence, without guessing intentional stop or old heartbeat.
safety_semantics.lower_bound: कुल ट्रैजेक्टरी का आँकड़ा न्यूनतम सीमा explicitly qualifies trajectories.
safety_semantics.hidden_descendants: और उप-एजेंट नीचे counts hidden nodes, not levels; example 7 hidden siblings -> 7 more subagents below.
safety_semantics.answering: जवाब दे रहा है labels effective answering model; info_panel.py:937-942 binds process.effective_model, not current response status.
safety_semantics.credentials_set: सेट is conventional technical Hindi configured/stored count, not a person being appointed; none-stored neighbor is कोई संग्रहीत नहीं.
safety_semantics.durations: Both whole fields have unmeasured/other with exact original argument names; अज्ञात is invariant/native predicate; running-duration label natural; unknown does not become zero. Native-unit sample interpolation preserved. info/copy.py:111-132 explicitly reuses wire.session_status duration keys.
